topic.source_contract: Public rights of way, legal orders and highway-adoption evidence

facts.guard: authority duty is not proof of an exact route
online depiction is not a substitute for definitive record

facts.scope: objections to definitive-map and public-path orders
facts.guard: order process is not confirmed route change
decision must be matched to exact order and effective status

facts.effect: adopted roads become maintainable at public expense
facts.guard: proposed adoption is not completed adoption

scope_guards: The definitive map and statement are the legal record; generic web maps are discovery aids.
Footpaths, bridleways, restricted byways and byways open to all traffic remain distinct.
A displayed track or road is not evidence of a public right of way.
A modification, diversion or extinguishment application is not effective until the legal process is complete.
Rights-of-way orders and road-adoption processes are distinct.
A planning condition or adoption proposal is not proof that a road is highway maintainable at public expense.
Public rights, private easements, highway extent and HMLR title are not interchangeable.
No score or promotion is written without exact definitive statement, order status, highway search, title and site geometry.
